{{Top|leg}}
A '''triplex circuit''' was a component. If installed in a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] in place of a [[duplex circuit]], the diagnostics would register that there was no problem with the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] system. However, when activated, the shields would not raise. This problem could be fixed with a [[codepatch]].
